retrieved.title: Ticketing System integration with Okta failing
retrieved.description: [TCK-84949] Ticket raised because the Ticketing System integration with Okta has stopped syncing and shows repeated authentication failures. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The Okta API credentials used by Ticketing System had expired; rotated the token, stored it in the secrets manager, and re-enabled the sync job.
